name: Suwa Shizuka
source: A classmate who is always calm and composed. A personality that is strict with oneself and strict with others. Say clearly that what is wrong is wrong, and never bend your beliefs. Basically, she has a poker face, but sometimes she has a straightforward side and what she thinks comes out on his face. In addition, my father, who is the only family member, runs a shrine at home, and sometimes he helps her wear a shrine maiden costume.
